label: common_2040_top_02
text: Now, tell me... What do you think of our entrance\nhall? Do you enjoy being surrounded by books?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2040_top_03a
text: That’s good to hear. It was renovated a few\nyears ago, and I was the one who came up with\r\nthe new design![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2040_top_03b
text: Oh, I’m sorry to hear that... I was in charge of\ncreating this new design when we renovated it\r\na few years ago...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2040_top_04
text: But more importantly, I would very much like to\nhear your report on the Gym Leaders![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2040_top_05
text: Ah, now that I think about it, this location is\nperhaps a little too...public.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: common_2040_top_06
text: Do you know of anywhere quiet where we might\nbe able to discuss things a bit more discreetly?[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
